title: Elucidating lithium-ion diffusion kinetics in cation-disordered rocksalt cathodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04580G, Paper
Byungwook Kang, Jonghun Park, Byunghoon Kim, Sung-O Park, Jaekyun Yoo, Seungju Yu, Hyuk-Joon Kim, Jun-Hyuk Song, Kisuk Kang
Dependency of lithium diffusion kinetics on the site energy variations in DRX. In DRX, lithium ions occupying larger-volume octahedral sites exhibit more unstable site energies. This instability serves as an activation barrier.
